title: Turtle in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shell -->

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#3CB371'/>

  <line x1='62' y1='52' x2='80' y2='52' stroke='#1E6B47' stroke-width='2'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#7EC850'/>

  <!-- Front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7EC850'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='66' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7EC850'/>
  <!-- Back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6DB840'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6DB840'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M80 55 Q88 52 86 58' stroke='#7EC850' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
